jobs.title: Capacity Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

Coalition partners with insurance and reinsurance carriers who delegate authority to Coalition to write standalone Cyber insurance, open market Cyber reinsurance, and a Professional Liability insurance package (D&O, EPL, Fiduciary, and Crime). In this role, you will help Coalition manage these key strategic relationships with insurers/reinsurers, and broking partners that support those delegated authority relationships and structures. This role will also engage with and support Coalition’s  balance sheet vehicles which include captives, sidecars, and full-stack (Admitted) insurance paper. You will be responsible for external engagement and managing day-to-day operations with these partners, including overseeing data sharing, audits, compliance with contractual obligations, and coordinating internal teams’ support (e.g., product development, carrier compliance and due diligence needs, tech enhancements geared towards carriers).

We are seeking a team-oriented individual with deep (re)insurance experience who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, high-growth environment like Coalition, but can “speak the language of”, build relationships with, and be the key point of contact for traditional carriers. Candidates should be able to operate with minimal oversight to drive execution across our capacity strategy.

Responsibilities

- Oversee day-to-day operations with Coalition’s insurance and reinsurance carrier partners, including ensuring seamless communication and data sharing with external carrier partners and coordinating teams internally in support of carrier partner needs

- Support regular audits, due diligence and compliance requests with all carrier partners

- Facilitate the drafting and review of legal documents and contract wording with Coalition legal and carrier partners, and ensure compliance with carrier contracts and guidelines

- Engage with strategic broking partners that support capacity relationships

- Direct internal product development needs to support carrier partners

Skills and Qualifications

- 5+ years of reinsurance experience, or relevant experience at an insurance carrier or MGA

- Strong organizational and project managing skills

- Operational experience or legal contract wording background a plus

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (excellent communicator and collaborator)

- Strong attention to detail and analytical skills

- Self-directed and self-motivated

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $135,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $170,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

- 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

- Flexible PTO policy

- Annual home office stipend and WeWork access

- Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

- Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.

You will focus on driving adoption and revenue for Coalition’s Automated Detection and Response (ADR) platform, Wirespeed, through value-added resellers (VARs) and other key partners, while collaborating closely with Sales and Marketing on joint go-to-market initiatives. Your work will shape how partners experience Coalition, expand our reach into new customers, and drive meaningful impact on our growth.

Responsibilities

- Drive channel sales for Wirespeed by identifying, recruiting, and enabling high-potential VARs and other strategic partners in your territory.

- Own a quota-based book of business, managing both channel-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline from prospecting through close.

- Build and execute partner go-to-market plans in collaboration with Sales and Marketing including campaigns, enablement, and co-selling motions.

- Plan and execute partner events, webinars, and trade show engagements to create demand, accelerate deals, and strengthen relationships.

- Develop strong, multi-level relationships within partner organizations, from executives to front-line sellers, to increase mindshare and deal velocity.

- Leverage CRM and partner management tools to forecast accurately, report on performance, and continuously refine your territory and account strategy.

- 5+ years of experience in channel management, channel sales, or business development with a proven record of achieving or exceeding revenue targets through partners.

- Experience working with VARs, distributors, or other indirect channels, ideally in cybersecurity, SaaS, or related technology sectors.

- Collaborative, self-motivated, and results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on quality, customer impact, and doing what is right for partners and end customers.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, balancing multiple partners, programs, and opportunities while maintaining clarity on priorities.

- Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with experience presenting to executives and facilitating partner enablement sessions.

- Comfort using social media and digital channels for professional networking, partner engagement, and market presence.

- Strong organizational, creative, and problem-solving skills, with a data-informed approach to managing pipeline and forecasting.

- Proficiency with office productivity suites (Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides), CRM systems such as Salesforce, and partner or channel management tools.

- Prior experience working with distributed teams and coordinating cross-functional initiatives across time zones.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the Role

Coalition is hiring a Senior Global Benefits Manager to join the People Operations team and help deliver a reliable, scalable benefits experience for our distributed, international workforce.

This role will lead Coalition’s global benefits strategy and roadmap, including plan design, market competitiveness, regional harmonization, employee experience, and long-term program priorities. You will also lead day-to-day benefits administration and the ongoing operation of leave, retirement, pension, and other global benefits programs, while strengthening vendor management, compliance governance, employee support, and benefits data integrity. You will partner closely with People Operations, Payroll, Finance, Legal, HRIS, regional stakeholders, and external advisors to turn strategy into consistent, scalable global processes that reflect local requirements.

- Lead Coalition’s global benefits strategy and long-term roadmap, translating business and employee needs into competitive, consistent, and sustainable programs across markets.

- Strong command of benefits data, eligibility, payroll coordination, reconciliations, audits, and controls.

- Strong judgment, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, build practical processes, and prioritize in a global organization.

- Experience supporting benefits in a high-growth technology, financial services, insurance, or similarly regulated environment.

jobs.title: Underwriting Portfolio Analytics Principal, Reinsurance
jobs.description:
About us

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

Coalition is looking for a seasoned actuary with deep reinsurance expertise to join Coalition’s fast growing Coalition Re team. This role owns the full portfolio lifecycle — from pricing development and portfolio analytics to treaty governance and executive communication — and demands an exceptional blend of technical depth, strategic thinking, and leadership. This role also offers the opportunity to work directly alongside the underwriting review process to gain a deeper understanding of the marketplace. Over time, you will take ownership of smaller accounts and working-level broker relationships.

Responsibilities

- Set the vision for Coalition Re’s portfolio analytics framework and continuously improve pricing models, methodologies, and processes.

- Lead end-to-end pricing for complex reinsurance treaties, from assumption development and cash-flow projection through risk/return optimization.

- Lead portfolio profitability reviews and turn analytical findings into actionable underwriting and pricing recommendations.

- Establish and maintain pricing risk governance controls, with strong practices for data quality, documentation, and version control.

- Partner with underwriters, data scientists, engineers, and security experts to develop scalable, data-driven solutions for reinsurance decision-making.

- Communicate portfolio risk and pricing strategy clearly to senior leadership and external partners while building trusted relationships with brokers and cedants.

Skills and Qualifications

- 15+ years of pricing experience, including at least 6 years in reinsurance.

- ACAS or FCAS certification.

- Strong knowledge of actuarial pricing, reinsurance treaty structures, cash-flow modeling, and risk/return evaluation.

- Experience leading complex initiatives and setting standards for pricing models, methodology, governance, or portfolio analytics.

- Ability to structure ambiguous problems, develop data-driven solutions, and balance near-term delivery with long-term business outcomes.

- Strong communication and influencing skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

- Proven ability to build credibility and trust with senior leaders, underwriters, brokers, cedants, and cross-functional partners.

- Exceptional attention to detail, particularly in data quality, documentation, metrics, and model version control.

Bonus Points

- Pricing experience in cyber insurance or cyber reinsurance.

- Experience building and monitoring an advanced pricing or portfolio analytics framework.

- Experience working with external regulators, carriers, and reinsurance brokers.

- Experience collaborating with data science, engineering, or security teams to develop analytical solutions.

Compensation

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. The US base salary for this position ranges from $173,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $240,000/year in our highest geographic market. Consistent with applicable laws, an employee's pay within this range is based on a number of factors, which include but are not limited to relevant education, skills, job-related knowledge, qualifications, work experience, credentials, and/or geographic location. Your recruiter can share more on target salary for your location during the interview process. Coalition, Inc. reserves the right to modify this range as needed.

Perks

- 100% medical, dental and vision coverage

- Flexible PTO policy

- Annual home office stipend and WeWork access

- Mental & physical health wellness programs (One Medical, Headspace, Wellhub, and more)!

- Competitive compensation and opportunity for advancement

Why Coalition?

Work at Coalition is centered on the joint mission to Protect the Unprotected. We have built a remote-first, highly inclusive culture that welcomes people from diverse backgrounds. We trust each other to take responsibility, share ownership of outcomes, and put in the work together to protect businesses from digital risk. Coalition’s exceptional growth stems from its ability to address real-world problems for organizations of all sizes while remaining true to our founding values of character, humility, responsibility, purpose, authenticity, and inclusion.

We’re always looking for collaborative, inquisitive individuals to join #OurCoalition.
